dict.string: Notch Assistant controls Spotify playback, asks System Events to put the Mac to sleep, runs your shortcuts (such as Do Not Disturb), and opens the YouTube video you asked for in your browser, when you tell it to.
Alfred reads your calendar aloud when you ask, such as what is on my calendar tomorrow. It never changes events.
Only when hand gestures are turned on: Alfred watches for an open palm (start listening) or a fist (cancel). Nothing is recorded or stored.
Alfred looks up the people you ask to call, text or email. Contacts stay on this Mac.
Notch Assistant finds and opens files here when you ask, by name and date only. It never reads what's inside them.
